title: Initial Release
release_notes:
- Full inventory management with barcode and QR scanning
- Role-based login for all clinical staff
- Dashboard with live stock value, expiry alerts, and usage trends
- AI Insights, AI Chat Assistant, and smart purchasing recommendations
- Clinical room audits, stock transfers, and batch tracking
- Mobile web companion accessible over local Wi-Fi
- Admin-only Wi-Fi connection manager
- In-app software update checker with one-click install
- Backup and restore, session timeout, audit log
- PDF, Excel, and CSV export for all reports
